step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture represents Halter's livestock management and telemetry system. Telemetry originates from solar-powered Smart Collars on cows using two communication paths: MQTT over WiFi into AWS IoT Core, and LoRa radio via a farm base station into a third-party software instance hosted on Amazon EC2. Both ingestion paths write raw binary telemetry into a Raw Kinesis Stream. An AWS Lambda function is triggered to deduplicate and decode the raw binary into JSON format, publishing it to a Processed Kinesis Stream. An Apache Flink application running on Kinesis Data Analytics aggregates the location data into 10-minute buckets with geoindexing and saves the files to Amazon S3 partitioned by farm ID and date. For visualization, a Farmer requests a cow location heat map through the Mobile App. The request hits a backend service running on Amazon ECS Fargate, which orchestrates a query on Amazon Athena over the aggregated location data points in S3. ECS Fargate retrieves the query results from S3 and delivers the heat map data back to the Mobile App for display to the Farmer.

graph.name: Halter Livestock Telemetry and Heat Map Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture for Halter's livestock management system processing collar telemetry over MQTT and LoRa, running streaming analytics with Apache Flink, and performing query analytics via Athena and ECS Fargate.

nodes.name: Smart Collar
nodes.notes: Solar-powered, GPS-enabled collar attached to cows. Transmits telemetry via WiFi/MQTT or LoRa radio.

nodes.name: IOT CORE
nodes.notes: Receives MQTT telemetry directly from smart collars when on WiFi.

nodes.name: EC2
nodes.notes: Hosts third-party software receiving long-range LoRa radio data from farm base stations.

nodes.name: RAW KINESIS STREAM
nodes.notes: Stores raw binary data ingested from IoT Core and EC2; contains duplicate records.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Deduplicates and decodes binary payloads into JSON format.

nodes.name: PROCESSED KINESIS STREAM
nodes.notes: Main stream delivering cleaned JSON location telemetry to backend services.

nodes.name: KINESIS ANALYTICS
nodes.notes: Runs Apache Flink application to aggregate location data into 10-minute buckets with geoindexing.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores aggregated location data files partitioned by farm ID and date.

nodes.name: ATHENA
nodes.notes: Executes MapReduce queries over ~25 million location data points in ~10 seconds.

nodes.name: ECS FARGATE
nodes.notes: Orchestrates Athena queries and fetches resulting heat map data files from S3.

nodes.name: Mobile App
nodes.notes: Mobile application used by farmers to request heat maps and manage virtual fences.

nodes.name: FARMER
nodes.notes: Farmer requesting pasture health reports and cow location heat maps.
